categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Adds a new BlockingQueue threading primitive and adds a txoutsetsummary subcommand to bitcoin-util.
categories.rationale: Introduces a reusable BlockingQueue concurrency primitive and expands bitcoin-util CLI tooling. While primarily implemented to support snapshot loading, new shared threading utilities require review for correctness and API design in their own right.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Substantially alters assumeutxo snapshot processing, txdb coin serialization, and LevelDB writing in loadtxoutset.
categories.rationale: Substantially optimizes assumeutxo snapshot loading by replacing the sequential import path with a parallelized LevelDB pipeline. According to the author, this avoids redundant staging into CCoinsViewCache and eliminates fsync write gating, directly speeding up initial node readiness during snapshot imports.
